_doc: One entry per model. route: openrouter | codex. effort: reasoning effort passed explicitly (openrouter: reasoning.effort; codex: model_reasoning_effort). price_in/price_out are USD per 1M tokens (null where not applicable); price_source says where the figure was SEEN and price_date when. To add a model: add an entry here, then run: python experiments/model_bakeoff/run_bakeoff.py --model <key>

bunny.price_source: https://openrouter.ai/stealth/space-bunny-alpha (page text shows no price; 'free' is from a search-result summary only, NOT confirmed by builder)
bunny.note: stealth model; prompts and completions may be retained by the provider, not used for training (page text read 2026-10-06)

luna.price_source: ChatGPT Plus subscription via Codex CLI; no per-token cost. OpenRouter list price for reference: 0.10 in / 0.50 out per 1M (api/v1/models 2026-10-06)

sol.price_source: ChatGPT Plus subscription via Codex CLI. OpenRouter list price for reference: 2 in / 10 out per 1M (api/v1/models 2026-10-06)
